names.en: Residential Dwellings: Values, Mean Price and Number by State and Territories

structure.description: Dataset: RES_DWELL_ST. Price indexes for established houses and attached dwellings as well as an aggregated residential property price index. Estimates of changes in residential property prices and the total value of Australia's dwelling stock, and preliminary housing market activity data. Provides estimates of changes in residential property prices in each of the eight capital cities of Australia. Unit of measure: AUD/Number. Geographic coverage: Australia/State/GCCSA. Catalogue number: 6416.0
